Tecnodati S.R.L. is an unverified OpenStreetMap record, not a confirmed data center, and it carries no listed power capacity.

The entry is a single node tagged telecom=data_center near Parma, Italy, with a name that fits an Italian IT or data-services company. The record's own research notes that no operator website, press coverage, or business registration was confirmed, and that the search quota ran out before verification. The name is on-theme, which is more than can be said for other Italian records in the same dataset, but a plausible name is not evidence of a facility.

For AI infrastructure, the meaningful number here is zero megawatts. A data center that matters to compute scaling has a power figure attached, and this record has none. Nothing in the data indicates land, grid connection, cooling, or servers, so it cannot be counted toward capacity in any direction.

What the data does not cover is nearly everything: no operator, no website, no build date, no capacity, no confirmation the tag is accurate. The only geographic anchor is a coordinate and a distance to Parma Airport. Treat this as a candidate for follow-up research, not as a facility.
